## Architectures

<a id="canary-qwen"></a>

### Canary-Qwen

Transcribes English speech and offers a separate text-language mode for follow-up processing.

**Architecture:** FastConformer audio encoder connected to Qwen2.5.

[Code](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Speech) · [Weights](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/canary-qwen-2.5b)

<a id="glm-asr-nano"></a>

### GLM-ASR Nano

Transcribes speech in English, Mandarin and Chinese dialects, including noisy recordings.

**Architecture:** Compact audio encoder and GLM language decoder.

[Code](https://github.com/zai-org/GLM-ASR) · [Weights](https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-ASR-Nano-2512)

**Open license:** code [MIT](https://github.com/zai-org/GLM-ASR/blob/main/LICENSE) · weights [MIT](https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-ASR-Nano-2512/blob/61ba4e0b3309b6656edea3e93e419f7bd5c61957/README.md)

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** S → T · **Interaction:** text-output

Editorial summary of documented inputs and outputs; internal architecture is not shown.

<a id="granite-speech-3-3"></a>

### Granite Speech 3.3

Transcribes and translates speech while retaining a text language-model interface.

**Architecture:** Speech encoder and projector with modality-specific language adapters.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.08699) · [Code](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/tree/main/src/transformers/models/granite_speech) · [Weights](https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-speech-3.3-8b)

<a id="qwen3-asr"></a>

### Qwen3-ASR

Identifies languages and transcribes speech across languages and dialects.

**Architecture:** Speech-recognition adaptation of the Qwen3-Omni backbone.

<a id="vibevoice-asr"></a>

### VibeVoice-ASR

Transcribes long recordings with speaker labels and timestamps in one pass.
